purpose: PR B of the Docket hosted beta (builds/beta/plan.md rev 4, approved by Cristian 2026-11-19): in beta, a signed-in visitor can send a fresh synthetic sample document through the real pipeline with live model answers, within per-address and daily caps, with a stop before the daily budget runs out and a kill switch that works without a restart. Local mode is unchanged. Nothing is deployed by this PR.
mechanism: docket/corpus.py gains a one-document generator; corpus.generate and its draws are unchanged. docket/corpus.py derives the sample case types from CASE_TYPES minus a named exclusion dict, NOT_SAMPLES, with reasons (corrupt, encrypted, zero_byte, non_pdf end rejected; empty_text_layer is the same file every seed; exact_duplicate needs a partner; graded_evidence has about 2,000 possible files so seeds repeat), leaving 11 types; docket/beta_samples.py holds their plain labels. GET /beta/samples (gated, 404 in local mode) lists the types with plain labels and the state ready, off or paused. POST /beta/samples (gated, 404 locally) takes one case type, checks the kill switch, then the daily ledger headroom against one document's worst-case price (classify plus choose on the longest text, computed from the gateway), then reserves an address slot (rolling 60 minutes, sample_sends rows under a per-address advisory lock, 20 max) and a day slot (one conditional upsert on sample_counts per UTC day, 300 max) in one transaction, then generates a PDF with a server-chosen seed and submits it through the normal ingress with source sample and sender Sample generator. The address cap answers 429 with Retry-After and a message naming the wait in whole minutes; the day cap answers 429 with Retry-After set to the seconds until midnight UTC and a message saying to try again tomorrow; paused (ledger) and off (switch) answer 503. The kill switch lives in the beta_flags table, set by docket beta-switch on|off (refuses outside beta); no row means on. In beta the gateway, and the Anthropic transport before every HTTP request including the JSON-prompt resend after a schema 400, read the switch and raise BudgetExceeded, so a document ends failed/budget_exceeded with no workflow change; documents in review stay reviewable. spike-models reads the switch in beta. /reviewer/session, /beta/samples and POST /review/{id}/{action} parse their bodies from raw bytes with fixed 422 messages in both modes. GET /documents/{id} adds filename and sender. web/src/main.ts adds a beta-only sample panel above the queue (picker, one filled send button, a status line, a shared-queue note), a plain processing box ('Docket is reading this document.') and a plain budget-failure sentence; after a send it refreshes only the queue unless the sample itself is open. A migration adds sample_counts, sample_sends and beta_flags. DESIGN.md records the sample panel.
decisions: The kill switch is in Postgres rather than an environment variable, because a running container's environment cannot change. It reuses BudgetExceeded rather than a new failure reason, so the workflow is unchanged. The address cap is a rolling window rather than clock-hour buckets, because a clock-hour bucket allowed 40 in 60 minutes (the same gap PR A's review found on the lockout). The daily cap stays a single atomic upsert per UTC day. Samples are generated by a separate one-document function so the committed corpora and recordings keep their exact random draws. A slot taken by a send that then fails at ingress stays taken (fails closed). Out of scope for PR C: the nightly reset, its resetting flag and the pruning of sample_sends rows.
readers: README.md and docs/operations.md: people running Docket locally or as the beta, and the operator who flips the kill switch. DESIGN.md is already updated for the panel. Comments in docket/beta_samples.py, docket/corpus.py, docket/llm/gateway.py, docket/llm/anthropic.py, docket/api.py, docket/cli.py and web/src/main.ts: the next maintainer.
